workflow: Test the match between WWOX cortical burst frequencies and BRV-sensitive astroglial release in an independent model.
evidence_basis: Sections 2.1.3, 2.2 and 4.3.2, 4.3.4–5; XML figure captions 3, 5 and 7. Data for chronic fast-ripple release are a separate comparison from ripple release.
Section 4.3.5 lists “0, 1, or 3 μM” while the figure 7 caption lists “0, 3 and 10 μM”. Figure images and raw observations were not analyzed in this pass.
Section 4.3 reports ten stimuli, ten bursts and matched energisation with different frequencies and burst intervals.
